name: micro_flowxs
description: PIT top-20 perps, cross-sectional long/short on 24h taker-flow imbalance residualised cross-sectionally on the 24h and 7d return, 6h decisions, overlapping hold, vol-targeted.
mechanism: Coins whose takers are net buyers beyond what their own price move explains attract continued demand (flow persistence / informed flow); the same-window return is controlled because it reverses at <=1d.
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

implementability_200.note: round_to_qty=True with load_bybit_instruments() on the stitched OOS weights; dropped share is an estimate (orders whose |delta notional| < max(minNotionalValue, minOrderQty*price) at the unrounded equity).

expectancy_units: USD per closed round trip on the $200 OOS account

causality.plus_walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward causality_checks=2 per fold raised nothing)

caveats: POST-HOC: the pre-registered time-series-residualised XS signal failed; this is the control regression that passed. Family trial count includes the whole screen.
Needs Binance taker-buy volume for ~20 coins live (public fapi klines); Bybit symbol mapping for 1000x tickers.
Long/short alt book: short legs on small caps can squeeze; slippage tier 8 bp for non-majors may be optimistic in stress.

49 symbols traded in the backtest are not in the current Bybit instrument list (delisted or renamed: MATIC->POL, RNDR->RENDER, FTM->S, 1000SHIB->SHIB1000, ...): live wiring needs a symbol map; historical names that no longer exist cannot be checked.
~57% of order changes are below Bybit minimums at $200 (small stagger rebalances); round_to_qty OOS Sharpe 1.11 vs 1.17.
screen_evidence: Pre-registered XS residual-z FAILED (results/micro_flowz_xs.json). The control 'raw rank(imb) next to rank(r_W), rank(r7d)' passed: FM t train/test 6.47/2.08 (W24,24h), 5.94/3.34 (W24,72h), 6.18/2.12 (W4,24h), 5.43/3.15 (W4,72h).
bug_hunt: FROZEN is resid='none': plain cross-sectional rank of the 24h taker-buy share - a coin-level characteristic, weekly (H=28) overlapping hold.

FUNDING is ~1/4 of the return: funding RECEIVED 8.9%/yr of equity OOS (funding_per_year -0.089). Dev-period frozen Sharpe 1.59 with funding vs 1.25 with funding=False. The long leg (high taker-buy share) tends to sit in negative-funding (short-crowded) coins - overlap with carry / short-squeeze exposure; check correlation with the carry modules.
Leg split (dev, frozen): long leg alone Sharpe 0.99 (net long the market), short leg alone 0.03; daily corr with BTC of the combined book 0.09, mean net weight +0.025.
Concentration: top-5 symbols (TRB, APT, BTC, SOL, SUI) = 55% of dev P&L over 206 names; TRB was the 2023 squeeze coin.

Dev-period worst trade -451% of notional (DOGE short, Jan 2021 squeeze: -$30, ~15% of equity at the time); OOS worst trade -99% of notional; 2 delisting closes in OOS; no liquidations. Single-name short squeezes are the tail risk (no per-name stop in this weights book).
Robust to an extra 6h decision lag (dev Sharpe 1.52 vs 1.59), 2x fees (1.46) and 3x slippage (1.31).
Random-timing 'runs' null ignored for the verdict: its shuffled continuous weights trade 491x/yr vs 292x for the strategy (biased low).

notes: null_secondary ignored for the verdict: runs-null turnover 491 vs strategy 292

verdict_rule:
Family-E verdict rule (applied identically to every module):
      p_used = the LARGER p-value of the two nulls, ignoring a random-timing 'runs' null whose
               mean turnover is > 1.5x the strategy's (the shuffled continuous weights then pay
               far more costs, which biases that null DOWN - see lab_bugs_found).
      promising: OOS Sharpe >= 0.8, p_used <= 0.05, deflated Sharpe (grid trials) >= 0.9 and
                 >= 60% of OOS calendar years positive.
      marginal : OOS Sharpe >= 0.5 and p_used <= 0.10.
      fails    : otherwise.
      Fragility downgrade (one level): any +/-1 grid-step neighbour of FROZEN with a negative
      dev Sharpe, or a dev Sharpe below 0.25 when fees are doubled (robustness_dev_frozen).
